create_pipeline_object_removal: create a StableDiffusionXL pipeline for object removal using attentive eraser with AAS and SARG guidance
run_pipeline_inpainting: run the attentive eraser pipeline to inpaint masked regions of an image with a text prompt
register_attention_editor: register a custom attention editor on the UNet to modify cross-attention during diffusion steps
invert_image_to_latents: invert a real image into noise latents using deterministic DDIM inversion for image-to-image tasks
prepare_mask_and_image: prepare mask and masked image tensors for the Stable Diffusion XL inpainting pipeline
